name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold development company focused on advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos Project located in Salta and Catamarca, Argentina. The flagship project received key environmental approvals from Salta authorities and was formally approved under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI) in 2026. The company is at the development stage and closed a C$50 million bought deal financing in mid-2026 to fund advancement toward construction.
